agent_observability.initial: Natural-language repair request, exact allowed source path, historical producer version, source entrypoint/listing and all nine visible records (three public input specifications in three regimes).
agent_observability.tools: Candidate-source reads/searches, read-only joblib1.2.0 producer-source reads/searches, public loader checks, and historical_artifact identity/length/prefix_hex. Joblib artifact inspection does not provide full raw bytes or full pickle disassembly to the model.
agent_observability.not_available: Fixed reader source, withheld fixtures, frozen oracle answers, and evaluator code are outside the repair surface.
agent_observability.no_hardcoding: Providing public example values permits diagnosis, not fixture-specific source branches; general source-policy review remains separate.

actual_flow: Verify the immutable historical artifact SHA256 and copy it to a temporary working.pkl.
Load the working copy with candidate joblib and mmap_mode=r+ for historical and current-roundtrip endian rows.
Record initial values, shape, numeric kind, itemsize, Python sum and is_memmap.
Add the case-specific delta to obj.flat[1], then record the same snapshot fields.
Call obj.flush(), dump the mutated object to resaved.pkl with compress=0/protocol4, and delete the parent object.
Start a fresh interpreter using the candidate reader; default joblib.load(working.pkl) records in-place persistence.
Start another fresh interpreter; default joblib.load(resaved.pkl) records explicit-resave persistence.
Compare all semantic snapshots and the is_memmap flag with frozen, input-validated observations.

critical_exactness.mutation_index: Second element in flat order: obj.flat[1].
critical_exactness.mutation_delta: Case-specific input delta, NOT +7. First public case uses91211; six big-endian cases use91211+3*i; native-order preservation case uses4301.
critical_exactness.restart_mode: Neither restart load specifies mmap_mode; both use default ordinary joblib.load.
critical_exactness.byteorder: Byte order is recorded only as a diagnostic. Acceptance compares numeric kind/itemsize but does not require identical byte-order notation after ordinary reload.
critical_exactness.working_file_vs_resaved: The work-file restart must show the in-place flush; passing only the separately dumped resaved file is insufficient.
critical_exactness.test_mode: A separate fresh_api joblib row constructs and dumps a current object, then loads with mmap_mode=None. It does not test writable mmap or in-place restart.

saved_base_failure.interpretation: Base loads correctly, mutates correctly in memory and resaves correctly, yet flush does not persist the mutation in the original working file. Thus a detached byte-order-converted memmap can pass type/load checks and still violate the contract.

paper_pseudocode.caption: Simplified historical-case verifier, not runnable code. S records values, shape, numeric kind, width and sum; fresh_process_load uses default joblib.load in a new process.
paper_pseudocode.code:
work = copy(immutable_file)                  # old joblib 1.2.0 bytes
a = candidate.load(work, mmap_mode="r+")
assert is_memmap(a) and S(a) == input_snapshot
a.flat[1] += delta                          # public case: 23 + 91211
a.flush()
candidate.dump(a, resaved, compress=0, protocol=4)
del a
expected = snapshot_after_declared_mutation
assert fresh_process_load(work) == expected
assert fresh_process_load(resaved) == expected

helper_meanings.S: The array_snapshot fields, not raw bytes or byte order.
helper_meanings.input_snapshot: Frozen snapshot independently validated against input values/shape/type.
helper_meanings.snapshot_after_declared_mutation: Expected snapshot derived from the declared input delta, not from trusting the candidate observed mutation.
helper_meanings.fresh_process_load: One new interpreter calls candidate joblib.load(path) with no mmap_mode and returns S(result).

simplifications: Temporary-directory creation and artifact SHA check are omitted from code but required by real evaluator.
The pseudocode merges separate observation collection and frozen-reference judging into asserts.
Subprocess construction, JSON transport, timeouts and error recording are omitted.
Only the historical public case is illustrated; fresh_api/current_roundtrip and other fixtures remain required.

definitions.defect_lineage: One upstream bug/fix history bound to an affected reader and its producer versions; files and repeated processes provide observations within that lineage.
definitions.H: Historical: read immutable bytes generated by a genuine older producer release.
definitions.F: Fresh construction: start from current input data rather than old bytes; for joblib this also includes ordinary current dump/load with mmap_mode=None.
definitions.R: Current roundtrip: construct, serialize and read using the candidate current implementation before exercising the continuation checks.
definitions.regime_caution: H/F/R identify the initial input path, not independent defects or three isolated phases. Each observation includes its declared continuation and fresh-process persistence checks.
definitions.empty_Interval: A zero-row pandas column whose declared dtype represents intervals; it still has a dtype even though it contains no values.
definitions.vacuous_inference: all(predicate(v) for v in []) is true without checking any value. In v1, that empty-set result wrongly authorized integer-kind inference for an empty Interval column.
definitions.v2_scope: The nonempty/kind guard prevents this inference and preserves the conservative backport behavior; it does not restore the already-lost empty Interval dtype.

compact_paper_definitions.lineage: A lineage groups one upstream defect and fix with its affected reader and historical producers; payloads are observations within it.
compact_paper_definitions.regimes: H reads historical bytes; F starts from freshly constructed data; R first serializes and reads current data. Each then exercises declared use and persistence.
compact_paper_definitions.interval: An empty Interval column retains interval dtype but has no values. A universal value predicate passes vacuously on emptiness; v2 requires nonempty evidence before inferring numeric kind.

interval_saved_control.original: Empty interval[int64,right] plus empty int16/int32/int64 columns
interval_saved_control.meaning: v2 removes its extra integer misclassification while retaining pre-existing interval information loss. No claim to fully repair Interval support.

judgment: Suitable for the paper after keeping helper/default-load and case-specific-delta distinctions explicit.
scope: Read-only audit of existing task metadata, source and saved observations; this exported copy maps every source anchor to a verified file within this release. No new model or experiment was run.
